title: Cram session: 1 fantasy tip you need to know for all 32 teams

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Cram session: 1 fantasy tip you need to know for all 32 teams
sources.description: It’s time for a fantasy cram session! Matt Harmon is joined by Chris Harris of Harris Football to deliver one essential fantasy note for all 32 NFL teams. The duo speed-runs through the entire league, highlighting the players, situations and draft-day insights you need to know before your fantasy draft. If you only have time for one last fantasy football study session, this is it.
